steps.name: script
script: TIMEFORMAT='TIMING docker-info %R'; time docker info --format 'docker info: storage driver {{.Driver}}, cgroup v{{.CgroupVersion}} ({{.CgroupDriver}}), registry mirrors {{.RegistryConfig.Mirrors}}'
systemctl show containers.slice -p IOReadIOPSMax -p IOWriteIOPSMax -p IOReadBandwidthMax -p IOWriteBandwidthMax
for u in guest-agent containerd docker; do echo "$u.service runs in $(systemctl show -p ControlGroup --value $u.service)"; done
docker run -d --name cg docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04 sleep 60 >/dev/null; echo "a container runs in $(cut -d: -f3 /proc/$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Pid}}' cg)/cgroup)"; docker rm -f cg >/dev/null
result() { awk -v n="$1" -v w="$2" -v a="$3" -v b="$4" 'BEGIN { printf "RESULT %s: %d write IOs in %.1f s, %.0f write IOPS\n", n, w, b - a, w / (b - a) }'; }
TIMEFORMAT='TIMING small-files %R'; time docker run --rm -v /var/tmp:/t docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04 bash -c 'mkdir -p /t/x && for i in $(seq 50000); do echo x > /t/x/$i; done; sync'

TIMEFORMAT='TIMING fio-install %R'; time { docker run --name fio docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04 bash -c 'apt-get -qq update >/dev/null && apt-get -qq install -y fio >/dev/null 2>&1' && docker commit fio fio:local >/dev/null && docker rm fio >/dev/null; }

TIMEFORMAT='TIMING fio-randwrite %R'; time docker run --rm -v /var/tmp:/t fio:local fio --name=randwrite --directory=/t --rw=randwrite --bs=4k --iodepth=64 --ioengine=libaio --direct=1 --size=1G --runtime=120 --time_based
for u in guest-agent flr-registry-mirror containerd docker; do echo "BOOT $u $(( $(systemctl show -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic --value $u.service) / 1000 )) ms"; done
